Authored by Innerscene Corp (innerscene.com). Public domain: dedicated under CC0 1.0 Universal, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Free to use, modify and redistribute for any purpose, with no credit required.

Source.glb is the original download. Human.fbx is our optimized conversion:
34,146 triangles, one skinned body including eyes, 163 original bones and all
30 finger bones. Imported helper object removed; weighted decimation prioritizes
hand detail; UV coordinates and skin weights retained. No source animation or
texture image is included. Materials/outfits are supplied by the game project.
Reproduce with Blender 4.3.2 and Tools/Convert-UnifiedHuman.py from repository root.
Exact source URL and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in SourceManifest.json.
